youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用居家辦公情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從不用通勤的早晨、把餐桌改成工位、網速卡頓、上線打卡、晨會回報進度、共享文件、中午熱飯收快遞、下午連軸會議、孩子敲門處理，到下班關電腦、寫日報、起身拉伸、約明天辦公室見，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Working from Home phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering no commute, a dining-table desk, slow Wi-Fi, logging in, morning stand-up updates, shared files, reheating lunch, back-to-back meetings, kids at the door, writing the daily report, stretching, and meeting a colleague at the office tomorrow. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not need to drive today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt nid tə draɪv təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天不用開車出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means one more hour of sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz wʌn mɔr ˈaʊər əv slip/
dialogue.zh: 那就多睡一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the alarm did not wake me up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ðə əˈlɑrm dɪd nɑt weɪk mi ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 哎，鬧鐘根本沒有把我吵醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You slept right past eight o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 你直接睡過八點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No traffic lights on my way.
dialogue.zh: 我今天的路上沒有紅綠燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the hallway to your desk.
dialogue.zh: 只有從走廊到你的書桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you help me set up here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hɛlp mi sɛt ʌp hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你能幫我在這兒佈置一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we will use the dining table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, wi wɪl juz ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我們用餐桌當工位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chair is too low for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪs ʧɛr ɪz tu loʊ fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 這把椅子對我來說太低了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a cushion for your back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈkʊʃən fər jʊr bæk/
dialogue.zh: 我有一個靠墊給你墊腰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boy, the laptop screen feels small.
dialogue.zh: 天，筆電螢幕好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's hook up the big monitor.
dialogue.zh: 我們把大顯示器接上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did I put the cable?
dialogue.zh: 我的傳輸線放哪兒了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look in the drawer beside the router.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪn ðə ˈdrɔər bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈraʊtər/
dialogue.zh: 看看路由器旁邊的抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too dim, this little desk lamp.
dialogue.zh: 這台小台燈實在太暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The window gives you good light.
dialogue.zh: 窗邊的光線很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A taller stack of books would help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɔlər stæk əv bʊks wʊd hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 書再墊高一點會更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use these boxes under the screen.
dialogue.zh: 用紙箱墊在顯示器下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our Wi-Fi feels slow this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər waɪ faɪ filz sloʊ ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 今早我們的網速有點慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the neighbor is downloading again.
dialogue.zh: 可能是鄰居又在下載。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again, my video keeps freezing.
dialogue.zh: 我的視頻又一直在卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try restarting the router once.
dialogue.zh: 試著重啟路由器一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, the internet died for one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ, ði ˈɪntərˌnɛt daɪd fər wʌn ˈmɪnət/
dialogue.zh: 唉，網路斷了一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did it come back on its own?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt kʌm bæk ɑn ɪts oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 它自己恢復了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I sit right beside the router.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ sɪt raɪt bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈraʊtər/
dialogue.zh: 現在我就坐在路由器旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That should help your signal.
dialogue.zh: 那應該能改善你的信號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not stream music while I talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt strim ˈmjuzɪk waɪl aɪ tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 我講話的時候別放音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use my headphones instead.
dialogue.zh: 那我就戴耳機聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess who wants to bring me soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /gɛs hu wɑnts tə brɪŋ mi sup/
dialogue.zh: 你猜誰想端湯給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her you are busy until noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr ju ər ˈbɪzi ʌnˈtɪl nun/
dialogue.zh: 跟她說你忙到中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone here talks too loud.
dialogue.zh: 家裡每個人說話都太大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ask the kids to whisper.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æsk ðə kɪdz tə ˈwɪspər/
dialogue.zh: 我叫孩子們小聲一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we keep the door closed today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi kip ðə dɔr kloʊzd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天可以把門關著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will hang your sign there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ wɪl hæŋ jʊr saɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我把你的牌子掛在那。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This red sign means do not enter.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪs rɛd saɪn minz du nɑt ˈɛntər/
dialogue.zh: 紅牌子意思是請勿打擾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cat will ignore it anyway.
dialogue.zh: 貓咪才不會理它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fresh cup is waiting right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə frɛʃ kʌp ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 一杯熱咖啡正在這兒等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You looked tired, so I made two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊkt ˈtaɪərd, soʊ aɪ meɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 你看起來很睏，所以我煮了兩杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breakfast at my desk again.
dialogue.zh: 又在書桌前吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least you are not late.
dialogue.zh: 至少你沒有遲到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still in my warm pajama pants.
dialogue.zh: 我還是穿著暖暖的睡褲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real pants for the camera, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過上鏡還是要穿長褲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why dress up if you stay home?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ drɛs ʌp ɪf ju steɪ hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 待在家裡為什麼還要穿正式？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It puts me in work mode.
dialogue.zh: 那樣我才會進入工作狀態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, my shirt is wrinkled from sleeping.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ, maɪ ʃɜrt ɪz ˈrɪŋkəld frəm ˈslipɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 唉，我的衣服都睡皺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The steamer is in the bathroom.
dialogue.zh: 掛燙機在浴室裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more morning train crowds.
dialogue.zh: 再也不用擠早班火車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But no quiet train reading either.
dialogue.zh: 但也沒有安靜的車上閱讀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the dog wants his walk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə dɔɡ wɑnts hɪz wɔk naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你看，狗狗現在就要去散步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take him before your first meeting.
dialogue.zh: 第一個會議前帶他去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hand on the leash is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hænd ɑn ðə liʃ ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 一只手搭著牽繩就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will pull you down the steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl pʊl ju daʊn ðə stɛps/
dialogue.zh: 他會把你拉下樓梯的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This table is too near the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪs ˈteɪbəl ɪz tu nɪr ðə ˈkɪʧən/
dialogue.zh: 這桌子離廚房太近了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cook smells make you hungry at work.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊk smɛlz meɪk ju ˈhəŋgri æt wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 做菜的味道會讓你工作時肚子餓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we move the monitor by the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi muv ðə ˈmɑnətər baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 顯示器能搬到窗邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The glare will wash out your screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə glɛr wɪl wɑʃ aʊt jʊr skrin/
dialogue.zh: 反光會讓屏幕看不清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my desk stays in this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ dɛsk steɪz ɪn ðɪs rum/
dialogue.zh: 那我的桌子就留在這兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we eat lunch on the couch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi it lʌnʧ ɑn ðə kaʊʧ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們午餐就在沙發上吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These keyboard clicks are way too loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈkiˌbɔrd klɪks ər weɪ tu laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我敲鍵盤的聲音實在太大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy the silent keys this weekend.
dialogue.zh: 這週末買靜音鍵盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feet need a rest under the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /fit nid ə rɛst ˈʌndər ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 腳在桌子下面沒地方擱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This old dictionary works fine.
dialogue.zh: 這本舊字典墊著就很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my back already hurts by eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, maɪ bæk ɔlˈrɛdi hɜrts baɪ ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 唉，才十一點我背就疼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit up straight, my friend.
dialogue.zh: 坐直吧，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunlight keeps getting in my eyes.
dialogue.zh: 陽光一直閃進我的眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lower the curtain a few inches.
dialogue.zh: 把窗簾往下拉幾吋就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: House work and real work mix badly.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊs wɜrk ænd ril wɜrk mɪks ˈbædli/
dialogue.zh: 家務和正事混在一起很糟糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The laundry basket is calling you.
dialogue.zh: 洗衣籃在呼叫你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That basket can wait, it always does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈbæskət kæn weɪt, ɪt ˈɔlˌweɪz dʌz/
dialogue.zh: 那籃衣服先不管，它永遠都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will still be there at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl stɪl bi ðɛr æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 六點時它還會在那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is ringing the doorbell.
dialogue.zh: 有人在按門鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, only a paper flyer.
dialogue.zh: 別管，只是傳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This house has zero soundproofing.
dialogue.zh: 這房子完全不隔音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your microphone hears every word.
dialogue.zh: 你的麥克風什麼字都收得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On my list, a cancelling headset.
dialogue.zh: 我的清單上有一副降噪耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one is on sale.
dialogue.zh: 藍色那款正在特價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ring from my mug on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋ frəm maɪ mʌɡ ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我的杯子在桌上留了一個圈印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the coaster by your mouse.
dialogue.zh: 用滑鼠旁邊那個杯墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Working alone suits my quiet room.
dialogue.zh: 獨自工作很適合我安靜的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But lunch alone feels strange.
dialogue.zh: 但一個人吃中飯有點怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The printer is out of paper again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɪntər ɪz aʊt əv ˈpeɪpər əˈgɛn/
dialogue.zh: 打印機又沒紙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the closet near the door.
dialogue.zh: 去看看門邊的儲藏櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my second charger cable?
dialogue.zh: 我第二條充電線在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stayed at the office desk.
dialogue.zh: 它留在辦公室的桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All day long, my phone lives on silent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl deɪ lɔŋ, maɪ foʊn lɪvz ɑn ˈsaɪlənt/
dialogue.zh: 我的手機一整天都開著靜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you missed twenty texts too.
dialogue.zh: 那你也錯過二十則訊息囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the vacuum can wait until tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðə ˈvækjum kæn weɪt ʌnˈtɪl təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，吸塵留到今晚再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crumbs are under your chair.
dialogue.zh: 餅乾屑就在你椅子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This desk badly needs a water glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs dɛsk ˈbædli nidz ə ˈwɔtər ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 這張桌子好需要一杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will fill the big green bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl fɪl ðə bɪg grin ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我去裝滿那個大綠瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning light makes the plants happy.
dialogue.zh: 晨光照得植物很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set a pot beside your keyboard.
dialogue.zh: 擺一盆在你鍵盤旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Without the bus ride, I wake fresher.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈðaʊt ðə bʌs raɪd, aɪ weɪk ˈfrɛʃər/
dialogue.zh: 不用搭公車，我精神好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have more time for breakfast.
dialogue.zh: 你有更多時間吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not open the fridge every ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt ˈoʊpən ðə frɪʤ ˈɛvri tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 別每十分鐘開一次冰箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will hide the cookies.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我把餅乾藏起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the clock says nine already.
dialogue.zh: 等等，時鐘已經指到九點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your work starts in five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 你的工作五分鐘後開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, this desk is ready, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðɪs dɛsk ɪz ˈrɛdi, aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我想工位佈置好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks like a real office now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks laɪk ə ril ˈɔfəs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在看起來真像間辦公室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me log in right away.
dialogue.zh: 讓我馬上登入看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did your password work this time?
dialogue.zh: 這次密碼對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the system asks for a new code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈsɪstəm æsks fər ə nu koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那系統要一組新的驗證碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your email for the number.
dialogue.zh: 看看郵件裡的那組數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At last, online and on the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət læst, ˈɔnˌlaɪn ænd ɑn ðə klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 終於上線，也開始計時了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the timesheet needs that.
dialogue.zh: 好，工時表需要這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine messages came overnight.
dialogue.zh: 一夜之間來了九條訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Answer the boss first today.
dialogue.zh: 今天先回老闆那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This work chat never sleeps.
dialogue.zh: 這個工作群組從來不睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mute it till your break.
dialogue.zh: 先靜音到你休息再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you read my status for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju rid maɪ ˈstætəs fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 你能幫我看一下狀態欄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says you are in a meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ju ər ɪn ə ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫你在開會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the team meets at ten sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə tim mits æt tɛn ʃɑrp/
dialogue.zh: 對了，團隊十點整開會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you know your speaking order?
dialogue.zh: 你知道自己的發言順序嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quick list, then the date.
dialogue.zh: 先快速列個清單，再講日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you have ten minutes to spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju hæv tɛn ˈmɪnəts tə spɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那你還有十分鐘空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone looks so sleepy on camera.
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭裡每個人都好睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look awake enough, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得你還算清醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me report what I finished.
dialogue.zh: 我來報告一下完成了什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell only the main part.
dialogue.zh: 好，只講重點那部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three tickets closed before bed last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈtɪkəts kloʊzd bɪˈfɔr bɛd læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚睡前我結掉了三張工單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did anyone test your fixes?
dialogue.zh: 有人測試過你的修正嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One task is still half done.
dialogue.zh: 有一項任務還只做一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say that part needs more time.
dialogue.zh: 就說那部分還要多點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, my own part is stuck on one error.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, maɪ oʊn pɑrt ɪz stʌk ɑn wʌn ˈɛrər/
dialogue.zh: 首先，我自己的部分卡了一個錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the group for help today.
dialogue.zh: 今天就在群組裡求助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This call makes me sound so tense.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kɔl meɪks mi saʊnd soʊ tɛns/
dialogue.zh: 這通電話讓我聽起來好緊繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down and smile a bit.
dialogue.zh: 說慢一點，稍微笑一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Man, my microphone is muted again.
dialogue.zh: 天，我的麥克風又被靜音了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They cannot hear you at all.
dialogue.zh: 他們完全聽不到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I raise my hand here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ reɪz maɪ hænd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡要怎麼舉手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click the small hand icon.
dialogue.zh: 點那個小小的手圖示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One click, then nothing moved at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klɪk, ðɛn ˈnʌθɪŋ muvd æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 點了一下，卻完全沒有反應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, the app lags sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，軟體偶爾會延遲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my name shows with a hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ neɪm ʃoʊz wɪθ ə hænd/
dialogue.zh: 現在我的名字旁邊有手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for your turn to talk.
dialogue.zh: 就輪到你再發言。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So soon, the host called my name.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ sun, ðə hoʊst kɔld maɪ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 太快了，主持人就點我的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just share your one idea.
dialogue.zh: 就把你那一個想法講出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our shared file refuses to open.
dialogue.zh: 我們共享的檔案打不開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Refresh the page and wait.
dialogue.zh: 重新整理頁面等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone typed over my whole row.
dialogue.zh: 有人把我那整行蓋掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can restore the old version.
dialogue.zh: 你可以還原舊的版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the edit history button?
dialogue.zh: 編輯紀錄的按鈕在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is under the three dots.
dialogue.zh: 在那三個點裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One comment waits on page two.
dialogue.zh: 有一則評論放在第二頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you tag the project lead?
dialogue.zh: 你有標記專案負責人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will see the red dot today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl si ðə rɛd dɑt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 她今天會看到那個紅點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it is out of your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt ɪz aʊt əv jʊr hændz/
dialogue.zh: 那就不歸你管了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you open the link I sent?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈoʊpən ðə lɪŋk aɪ sɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 你打得開我傳的連結嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says you need permission.
dialogue.zh: 它說你需要權限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right away, I will request access.
dialogue.zh: 我馬上申請開通權限。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The admin sits in that meeting too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ædˈmɪn sɪts ɪn ðæt ˈmitɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 管理員也在那場會議裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, my screen share is the wrong tab.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, maɪ skrin ʃɛr ɪz ðə rɔŋ tæb/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我分享的畫面是錯的分頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop sharing and choose the right one.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ˈʃɛrɪŋ ænd ʧuz ðə raɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 先停止分享再選正確的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They see my private notes too!
dialogue.zh: 他們也看到我的私人筆記了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close that window very fast.
dialogue.zh: 趕快把那個視窗關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, only the slide is live now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈoʊnli ðə slaɪd ɪz laɪv naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，現在只分享那一頁投影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your camera still shows you sweating.
dialogue.zh: 你的鏡頭還在拍你流汗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn my face off?
dialogue.zh: 我要把自己的影像關掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, people like seeing you talk.
dialogue.zh: 不用，大家喜歡看著你說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, the notes app did not save.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, ðə noʊts æp dɪd nɑt seɪv/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，筆記軟體沒有存檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it again from memory.
dialogue.zh: 那就憑記憶再打一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our team list has two new names.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr tim lɪst hæz tu nu neɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 我們團隊名單多了兩個新名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hello to them today.
dialogue.zh: 今天跟他們問個好吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their names yes, their faces no.
dialogue.zh: 名字認得，臉就沒見過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their camera is off, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我想他們的鏡頭是關著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the agenda jumped to the last item.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ði əˈdʒɛndə dʒʌmpt tə ðə læst ˈaɪtəm/
dialogue.zh: 然後議程直接跳到最後一項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So your topic got skipped.
dialogue.zh: 所以你的主題被跳過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After this, one message to the host.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðɪs, wʌn ˈmɛsɪdʒ tə ðə hoʊst/
dialogue.zh: 會後我給主持人發一條訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for a five minute slot.
dialogue.zh: 要一個五分鐘的發言時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These meeting notes need an owner.
dialogue.zh: 這份會議紀錄需要負責人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want me to type them for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt mi tə taɪp ðɛm fər ju/
dialogue.zh: 要我幫你打出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half the team writes in English now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðə tim raɪts ɪn ˈɪŋglɪʃ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一半的團隊現在都用英文寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your English is good enough.
dialogue.zh: 你的英文夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A phrase list lives by my desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə freɪz lɪst lɪvz baɪ maɪ dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 一張片語清單放在我桌邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it before every call.
dialogue.zh: 每場會議前都讀一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the green dot on my camera blinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə ɡrin dɑt ɑn maɪ ˈkæmərə blɪŋks/
dialogue.zh: 你看，我鏡頭上的綠燈在閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means they can see you.
dialogue.zh: 那就代表他們看得到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that file upload finish yet?
dialogue.zh: 那個檔案上傳完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stopped at ninety percent.
dialogue.zh: 它停在百分之九十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better yet, I will just email it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər jɛt, aɪ wɪl dʒʌst ˈimel ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這樣好了，我直接寄郵件過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Attach the smaller copy, please.
dialogue.zh: 請附那個小一點的版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the chat moved to a new thread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə tʃæt muvd tə ə nu θrɛd/
dialogue.zh: 然後討論搬到了新的討論串。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the old replies got lost.
dialogue.zh: 所以舊的回覆就不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone replied to my old joke.
dialogue.zh: 有人回了我之前開的玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send one emoji and stay quiet.
dialogue.zh: 發一個表情就好，別多說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the totals hide in this sheet?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ðə ˈtoʊtəlz haɪd ɪn ðɪs ʃit/
dialogue.zh: 總數藏在這張表格的哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row twelve has the totals.
dialogue.zh: 第十二行就是總數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One word answer from my boss today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wɜrd ˈænsər frəm maɪ bɔs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 老闆今天只回了我一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine? Or maybe not fine?
dialogue.zh: 是「好」？還是不太好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best to get the steps in writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst tə gɛt ðə stɛps ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 最好請他白紙黑字寫清楚步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, do not guess at work.
dialogue.zh: 很好，工作上別亂猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the clock says eleven forty.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，時鐘顯示十一點四十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one hour till lunch.
dialogue.zh: 再一小時就吃中飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four emails still on my plate.
dialogue.zh: 我手上還壓著四封郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write them in three lines each.
dialogue.zh: 每封寫三行就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, I hit send on all four.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, aɪ hɪt sɛnd ɑn ɔl fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 好了，四封我都按發送了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that went fast today.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，今天處理得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally, the morning block is finished.
dialogue.zh: 上午的工作時段終於結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your eyes, then find food.
dialogue.zh: 讓眼睛休息一下，然後找東西吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rice and soup need a quick heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs ænd sup nid ə kwɪk hit/
dialogue.zh: 飯和湯趕快熱一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes in the microwave.
dialogue.zh: 微波兩分鐘就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This food box has no lid.
dialogue.zh: 這個保鮮盒沒有蓋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover it with a small plate.
dialogue.zh: 用小盤子蓋一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch alone at my work desk.
dialogue.zh: 我一個人坐在工位上吃中飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least the food is warm.
dialogue.zh: 至少吃到的是熱食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, the rice is still cold inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ, ðə raɪs ɪz stɪl koʊld ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 唉，米飯中心還是涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat it one more minute.
dialogue.zh: 再熱一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the washing started this morning.
dialogue.zh: 對了，洗衣機一早就開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dryer stopped an hour ago.
dialogue.zh: 烘衣機一小時前就停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pile can wait until after lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə paɪl kæn weɪt ʌnˈtɪl ˈæftər lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那堆衣服可以留到午餐後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not leave them in a heap.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt liv ðɛm ɪn ə hip/
dialogue.zh: 別讓它們堆成一團。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A package waits at the front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpækɪdʒ weɪts æt ðə frʌnt dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 前門口放了一個包裹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Was it on your shopping list?
dialogue.zh: 你的購物清單上有買嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ordered new mouse batteries.
dialogue.zh: 我訂了滑鼠用的電池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old ones are dead.
dialogue.zh: 舊的那兩顆已經沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Man, the driver left it in the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæn, ðə ˈdraɪvər lɛft ɪt ɪn ðə reɪn/
dialogue.zh: 天，快遞把它留在了雨裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it in and dry the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt ɪn ænd draɪ ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 快拿進來把紙箱擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed for one more parcel too.
dialogue.zh: 我還簽收了另一個包裹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it, we will see.
dialogue.zh: 打開來看看吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box holds my new chair mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪs bɑks hoʊldz maɪ nu ʧɛr mæt/
dialogue.zh: 這箱是我的新椅墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the dog chew the old one?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə dɔg ʧu ði oʊld wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 舊的是被狗咬壞的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the afternoon means deep focus work.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ði ˌæftərˈnun minz dip ˈfoʊkəs wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 下午該專心深度工作了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close every tab you do not need.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ˈɛvəri tæb ju du nɑt nid/
dialogue.zh: 把不需要的分頁都關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A timer now reads fifty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 計時器現在設在五十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will not knock during that.
dialogue.zh: 那段期間我不會敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Face down, my phone rests on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs daʊn, maɪ foʊn rɛsts ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 我的手機朝下擱在架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the only way to focus.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ði ˈoʊnli weɪ tə ˈfoʊkəs/
dialogue.zh: 那樣才專得下心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours gone, just like that.
dialogue.zh: 兩個小時一下子就過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you finish the whole draft?
dialogue.zh: 整份初稿寫完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost, just one page left.
dialogue.zh: 快了，只剩一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finish it before your next call.
dialogue.zh: 下場會議前把它寫完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next three hours look fully booked.
dialogue.zh: 接下來三小時全都排滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Meetings back to back again?
dialogue.zh: 又是會議一場接一場？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None of these calls start on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn əv ðiz kɔlz stɑrt ɑn taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 這些會議沒有一場準時開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your whole day slips.
dialogue.zh: 那你整天都會一路延。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One call today had no agenda at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɔl təˈdeɪ hæd noʊ əˈdʒɛndə ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 今天有場會完全沒有議程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did anyone say the goal?
dialogue.zh: 有人說開會的目的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We talked an hour, nothing decided.
dialogue.zh: 我們講了一小時，什麼都沒決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That hour will not come back.
dialogue.zh: 那一小時也回不來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, I walked right out of that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, aɪ wɔkt raɪt aʊt ʌv ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 所以我直接退出了那場會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did anyone notice you leave?
dialogue.zh: 有人發現你離開了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Camera showed just one empty chair.
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭裡只剩一把空椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone surely saw that.
dialogue.zh: 一定有人看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, my son is knocking again.
dialogue.zh: 噢，我兒子又在敲門了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is he hurt or just bored?
dialogue.zh: 他是受傷了還是無聊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says his computer will not start.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛ sɛz hɪz kəmˈpjutər wɪl nɑt stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 他說他的電腦開不了機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him to wait five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 叫他先等五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is crying a little now.
dialogue.zh: 他現在有點想哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pause your screen and go help.
dialogue.zh: 先暫停屏幕過去幫他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Muted myself, then opened the door fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmjutəd maɪˈsɛlf, ðɛn ˈoʊpənd ðə dɔr fæst/
dialogue.zh: 我先靜音，趕快開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the room forget you existed?
dialogue.zh: 會議室裡把你忘了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He needed help with homework.
dialogue.zh: 他寫作業需要人幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him twenty minutes only.
dialogue.zh: 只給他二十分鐘喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Little one wants her tablet back.
dialogue.zh: 小的那個想把平板拿回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her the screen needs rest too.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr ðə skrin nidz rɛst tu/
dialogue.zh: 跟她說螢幕也該休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They drew on my printed page.
dialogue.zh: 他們在我列印的紙上亂畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print a fresh copy, very quietly.
dialogue.zh: 安靜地重印一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cartoons blast right through the wall.
dialogue.zh: 卡通聲直直穿過牆壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Headphones on, world away.
dialogue.zh: 戴上耳機，世界就遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the washing machine is beeping.
dialogue.zh: 咦，洗衣機在嘀嘀叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go pause it, then come back.
dialogue.zh: 先去按暫停，再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This water glass is completely empty.
dialogue.zh: 這只水杯完全空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring a full one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ə fʊl wʌn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在給你端一杯滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The team chat keeps asking for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tim tʃæt kips ˈæskɪŋ fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 團隊群組一直在等我回話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type one line, then go quiet.
dialogue.zh: 回一行就又安靜下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still four meetings left before five.
dialogue.zh: 五點前還有四場會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That ate your whole afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 那把你整個下午都吃掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A snack between these calls, please.
dialogue.zh: 這兩場會之間我想吃點東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are nuts in the jar.
dialogue.zh: 玻璃罐裡有堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Camera angle shows nothing but my ceiling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæmərə ˈæŋɡəl ʃoʊz ˈnʌθɪŋ bʌt maɪ ˈsilɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭角度只拍到我的天花板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it lower, on that book.
dialogue.zh: 放到那本書上，低一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my chin looks huge.
dialogue.zh: 現在我的下巴看起來超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the screen back a little.
dialogue.zh: 把螢幕往後移一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the host asked me a sudden question.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə hoʊst æskt mi ə ˈsʌdən ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 然後主持人突然丟問題給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did you say to them?
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼回答的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anyway, I promised the file by five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌweɪ, aɪ ˈprɑmɪst ðə faɪl baɪ faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 反正我答應五點前把檔案發出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So write it while you remember.
dialogue.zh: 那就趁還記得趕快寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry eyes, these screens are thieves.
dialogue.zh: 眼睛好乾，螢幕把水分偷走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the window a minute.
dialogue.zh: 望向窗戶一分鐘吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three calls ended, one left.
dialogue.zh: 三場結束了，還剩一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are almost at the finish.
dialogue.zh: 你快到終點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last call is with the client team.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst kɔl ɪz wɪð ðə ˈklaɪənt tim/
dialogue.zh: 最後一場是和客戶團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wear the blue shirt.
dialogue.zh: 那就穿那件藍襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hair looks totally wild today.
dialogue.zh: 今天頭髮亂得很誇張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On camera it looks fine, really.
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭裡其實很不明顯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the client call went well.
dialogue.zh: 哇，那場客戶會進行得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your shoulders were up to your ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈʃoʊldərz wɜr ʌp tə jʊr ɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 你緊張得肩膀都聳到耳朵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the doorbell rang during my screen share.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðə ˈdɔrˌbɛl ræŋ ˈdʊrɪŋ maɪ skrin ʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我分享畫面的時候門鈴響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who came at four o'clock?
dialogue.zh: 四點的時候誰來了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was the milk delivery again.
dialogue.zh: 又是送牛奶的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign for it, then keep it cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn fər ɪt, ðɛn kip ɪt koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 簽收之後要冰著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes got wet on the porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃuz ɡɑt wɛt ɑn ðə pɔrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋在陽台上弄濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody sees your feet today.
dialogue.zh: 反正今天沒人看到你的腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the chair beside me stays empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə tʃɛr bɪˈsaɪd mi steɪz ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我旁邊那張椅子一直空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No one else works from home here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wʌn ɛls wɜrks frəm hoʊm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這附近沒有別人也居家上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come sit with me at lunch.
dialogue.zh: 午餐時過來坐我旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then lunch feels like a break.
dialogue.zh: 這樣午餐才像真正的休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A whole day of camera smiles.
dialogue.zh: 一整天都只對著鏡頭微笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your real smile came through fine.
dialogue.zh: 你真正的笑容還是有出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five more minutes, then I close it.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv mɔr ˈmɪnəts, ðɛn aɪ kloʊz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再五分鐘我就關電腦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, no one waits.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，沒人等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved every file twice today.
dialogue.zh: 今天每個檔案都存了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, then shut it down.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，現在關機吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the whole work day is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə hoʊl wɜrk deɪ ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣一整天班就上完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels short and long somehow.
dialogue.zh: 感覺又短又長的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My list is empty at last.
dialogue.zh: 我的清單終於清空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed, and the camera too.
dialogue.zh: 關了，鏡頭也遮起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me lock my screen first.
dialogue.zh: 讓我先把屏幕鎖住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good habit, even at home.
dialogue.zh: 好習慣，在家也該這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now hold both arms over my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ hoʊld boʊθ ɑrmz ˈoʊvər maɪ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 現在把兩手舉過頭頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it, one, two, three.
dialogue.zh: 保持住，一、二、三。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, my neck made a small crack sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, maɪ nɛk meɪd ə smɔl kræk saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 哇，我脖子喀地發出一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means you sat too long.
dialogue.zh: 那就代表你坐太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daily note, coming right up.
dialogue.zh: 日報來了，這就寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three lines are enough there.
dialogue.zh: 那邊三行就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First done, then next, then what?
dialogue.zh: 先寫做完的，再寫接下來的什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, what, next. Simple.
dialogue.zh: 做完了、什麼、接著什麼，很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More done than I ever planned.
dialogue.zh: 完成的比我想像的還多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say that in your note too.
dialogue.zh: 這句話也寫進報告裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent, the note is away.
dialogue.zh: 發了，報告已經送出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, one less thing tonight.
dialogue.zh: 好，今晚少一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Legs asleep under me again.
dialogue.zh: 雙腿在桌子下面又麻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk a lap around the room.
dialogue.zh: 在房間繞一圈看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three hours straight without getting up.
dialogue.zh: 連續三個小時都沒有站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your back knows it too.
dialogue.zh: 你的腰也記得這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roll your shoulders back slowly.
dialogue.zh: 肩膀慢慢往後轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that feels so much better.
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen must have cold water.
dialogue.zh: 廚房應該有冰過的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big pitcher is full and cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪg ˈpɪʧər ɪz fʊl ænd koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 大水壺又滿又涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the cat saw me once today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðə kæt sɔ mi wʌns təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 連貓咪今天都只看到我一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you sat there all day.
dialogue.zh: 所以你一整天都坐在那。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time for my eyes to rest.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛該休息一下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No screen for ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘都別看屏幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, the sun is going down already?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ðə sʌn ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ daʊn ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 所以，太陽已經要下山了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gets dark by seven here.
dialogue.zh: 這邊七點就天黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still a total mess, this desk.
dialogue.zh: 這張桌子還是一片凌亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear it before dinner tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚吃飯前先把它收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those cups can wait until tonight.
dialogue.zh: 那些杯子留到今晚再收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The table needs one wipe.
dialogue.zh: 桌子只要擦一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam stayed on the line with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm steɪd ɑn ðə laɪn wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: Sam 留在線上陪我聊了一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did he talk about?
dialogue.zh: 他都聊了些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His printer broke again today.
dialogue.zh: 他的打印機今天又壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He surely complained a lot.
dialogue.zh: 他肯定抱怨了一堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then his dog jumped on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hɪz dɔg ʤʌmpt ɑn ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 然後他家的狗跳上書桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the camera catch that?
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭有拍到那一幕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, we laughed and laughed.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我們笑個不停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is good team work too.
dialogue.zh: 那也算團隊建設。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our group chat just said goodnight.
dialogue.zh: 我們群組剛剛都互道晚安了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send one small heart back.
dialogue.zh: 回一個小愛心吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Asked them about tomorrow's start time.
dialogue.zh: 我問了明天幾點開工。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same time, same calls.
dialogue.zh: 同一時間，一樣的會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels odd to wave goodbye on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz ɑd tə weɪv ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ ɑn skrin/
dialogue.zh: 隔著螢幕揮手道別感覺好怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wave and then silence.
dialogue.zh: 揮揮手，然後就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody heard me say bye at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi hɜrd mi seɪ baɪ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 根本沒人聽到我說再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room was already empty.
dialogue.zh: 會議室早就空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last meeting ended, finally.
dialogue.zh: 最後一場會終於結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How does freedom feel?
dialogue.zh: 自由的感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like the house got bigger.
dialogue.zh: 像房子突然變大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come eat while it is warm.
dialogue.zh: 趁熱過來吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Work friends asked for a Friday plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrk frɛndz æskt fər ə ˈfraɪˌdeɪ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 同事們約我週五見面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go, you need real faces.
dialogue.zh: 去吧，你該見見真人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is hard to feel close online.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz hɑrd tə fil kloʊs ˈɔnˌlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 在線上很難覺得親近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even a short coffee helps.
dialogue.zh: 就算只是喝杯咖啡也有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We share screens, not real days.
dialogue.zh: 我們共享屏幕，卻不共享生活。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So plan one lunch in person.
dialogue.zh: 那就排一頓面對面的午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some colleagues live far away.
dialogue.zh: 有些同事住得很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One office day covers it.
dialogue.zh: 一天進辦公室就能補回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two office days on my calendar still.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈɔfəs deɪz ɑn maɪ ˈkæləndər stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我行事曆上還有兩天要進辦公室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which day can I meet you there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʧ deɪ kæn aɪ mit ju ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 哪天我能去那邊找你？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First thing tonight, the bag gets packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst θɪŋ təˈnaɪt, ðə bæɡ ɡɛts pækt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚第一件事就是把包包收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not forget your badge again.
dialogue.zh: 別又把識別證忘在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my real key card, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz maɪ ril ki kɑrd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過我那張門禁卡在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hangs by the front door.
dialogue.zh: 它掛在大門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will fill my desk tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 明天誰會坐我的位子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chair is still yours.
dialogue.zh: 那張椅子還是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels odd to wear shoes again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz ɑd tə wɛr ʃuz əˈgɛn/
dialogue.zh: 又要穿鞋感覺好怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You forgot how hard straps are.
dialogue.zh: 你忘了皮帶多難扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the office in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju æt ði ˈɔfəs ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 早上辦公室見囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, book me a seat there.
dialogue.zh: 好，在那邊幫我留個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to say hello to real people.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm tə seɪ hɛˈloʊ tə ril ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 該跟活生生的同事們問好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring donuts, then everyone comes.
dialogue.zh: 帶甜甜圈去，大家就會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I will buy the big box.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, aɪ wɪl baɪ ðə bɪg bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 好，我買大盒的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the meeting starts sweet.
dialogue.zh: 那會議就有甜蜜的開場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A nap in my own chair.
dialogue.zh: 我在自己的椅子上小睡了一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At home, that is a real luxury.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt hoʊm, ðæt ɪz ə ril ˈlʌkʃəri/
dialogue.zh: 在家那樣睡算真的享受。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An early night for me, promised.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我要早睡，說定囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, the bed calls us.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，床在呼叫我們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine sharp in the small room.
dialogue.zh: 九點整，小會議室見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will save you a seat.
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你留一個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the notes from today.
dialogue.zh: 把今天那些筆記帶去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put them in your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pʊt ðɛm ɪn jʊr bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你放進包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, my old desk waits for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ, maɪ oʊld dɛsk weɪts fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 明天，我那張辦公桌會等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So will the lunch crowd.
dialogue.zh: 午餐那群人也會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today at home, tomorrow with them.
dialogue.zh: 今天在家，明天跟他們一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both days are still work.
dialogue.zh: 兩個日子都還是要上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This desk gets wiped in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs dɛsk ɡɛts waɪpt ɪn ə ˈmɪnət/
dialogue.zh: 這張桌子我馬上擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then come rest with us.
dialogue.zh: 然後過來跟我們一起休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Work from home, done for today.
dialogue.zh: 居家辦公，今天到此為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good job, now close that lamp.
dialogue.zh: 做得好，把那盞燈關了吧。
